description: This file contains partial class definitions and extension methods for integrating Cosmos DB-based reminders into the Orleans hosting framework. It includes extension methods for service and silo builders to add Cosmos reminders, a class hierarchy for Cosmos options and configuration, and an interface for executing Cosmos operations.

classes.name: CosmosOptions
classes.description: Abstract class encapsulating configuration options for Cosmos DB integration within Orleans, including container and database names, throughput, resource creation flags, client options, and an operation executor.

classes.name: CosmosOptionsValidator<TOptions>
classes.description: Validator class to verify the correctness of CosmosOptions configurations.

classes.name: CosmosReminderTableOptions
classes.description: Concrete class extending CosmosOptions, specific to reminder table configuration.

classes.name: ICosmosOperationExecutor
classes.description: Interface defining a method for executing Cosmos DB operations asynchronously.

methods.name: ConfigureCosmosClient
methods.description: Sets up a CosmosClient instance using a factory function.

methods.name: ConfigureCosmosClient
methods.description: Configures CosmosClient using account endpoint and authentication credentials.

methods.name: ConfigureCosmosClient
methods.description: Configures CosmosClient with a token credential.

methods.name: ConfigureCosmosClient
methods.description: Configures CosmosClient using account endpoint and a connection string.

methods.name: ConfigureCosmosClient
methods.description: Configures CosmosClient with a connection string.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the Cosmos options, ensuring required settings are appropriate.
